 Infrared Spectroscopy
Perkin Elmer Frontier FTIR
Description
Fourier transform infrared spectrometer with mid-IR (8300–350 cm−1) and far-IR (700–30 cm−1) capability at a best resolution of 0.4 cm−1. This is the department's only FIR capable spectrometer.
